Dear  *VELTECH* Student,* Congratulations on being shortlisted for the
Internship Program!*

As mentioned above, *Teachnook in collaboration with IBM & IIT BHUBANESWAR *is
organizing a 2 Month Training + Internship program designed by IBM.
*Interested students fill out the form, if you get shortlisted you will get
a call from our HR Team;*
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdupgtSZpfeKYC7nHLOoY3CN8TwippslcgNPK1xI5g9-02_KQ/viewform

*Top Preferred Courses: *
✅

*Artificial Intelligence.✅ Data Science.✅ Machine Learning.✅ Cloud
Computing.*
*✅ Full Stack Web Development.*

*Here is an outline of the program's structure.*

*First month: *During the first month of the program, IBM training will be
conducted in the form of live lectures, and you will have live mentorship
from industry professionals. You will have access to the IBM Portal, where
you can interact with the trainers and fellow students. Login credentials
will be provided to registered students.

*Second month:* Internship with live mentorship for projects from
professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students an experience
in solving real-world problems.

*Project 1 Minor Project**: *The minor project is an individual project,
and you will work on it independently. Resume building session.

*Project 2 Major Project: *The major project is a group project, and you
will work in a group of 15 interns, with specific responsibilities assigned
to each intern.
